Summary: Direct shutdown/reboot controls bypass documented no-host-mutation boundary.
Impact: Live shell can mutate host power state outside gateway/approval/audit policy.
Recommended Fix: Remove or route through explicit governed capability with approval/audit/env gate.

Summary: Default workspace / can become broad write authority.
Impact: Unset workspace can seed and activate broad root-scoped write policy.
Recommended Fix: Fail startup on root workspace unless explicit unsafe opt-in; never auto-activate / write policy.

Summary: Compose defaults to wildcard bind and wildcard opt-in.
Impact: Container bring-up exposes core more broadly by default.
Recommended Fix: Default to loopback or require explicit wildcard/token settings.

Summary: Legacy adapter invoke underreports network/model authority.
Impact: Model/network behavior can run outside accurate capability/modelruntime governance metadata.
Recommended Fix: Retire compatibility tool or split into accurate governed capabilities.

Summary: Packaged shell login uses hardcoded client-side credentials.
Impact: Login-like UI can misrepresent authentication strength.
Recommended Fix: Use OS/display-manager auth, server challenge, or relabel as splash/unlock.

Summary: Persisted Ollama base URL is less constrained than query override validation.
Impact: Authenticated settings can point model calls at unintended endpoints.
Recommended Fix: Apply same URL validation to persisted ollamaBaseUrl.

Summary: VM/Ollama docs conflict with Nix service enablement.
Impact: Operators may troubleshoot against wrong runtime state.
Recommended Fix: Align docs with services.ollama enablement or change config.

Summary: Plain http.Error responses remain across API route families.
Impact: Mixed error shapes hurt UI/error handling consistency.
Recommended Fix: Migrate route families to structured writeAPIError responses.

Summary: Runtime queue unavailable can display as zero.
Impact: Operators may read missing telemetry as healthy empty queue.

Summary: Operator app catalogs are duplicated and can drift.
Impact: Fallback UI can advertise stale/missing native apps.
Recommended Fix: Use backend catalog as sole authority or generate TS fallback.

Summary: Deep-link routes can be orphaned in shell window mode.
Impact: Routed detail pages may not render when shell windows exist.
Recommended Fix: Register detail surfaces or always provide routed detail host.

Impact: Policy source and audit metadata are ambiguous.
Recommended Fix: Keep one definition and add uniqueness test.

Summary: Stale status docs need supersession banners.
Impact: Old status files can be mistaken as current truth.
Recommended Fix: Add supersession notes pointing to current authority docs.

Summary: G3.5 future-language mixes with later G8 truth.
Impact: Implemented session work can look future-only.
Recommended Fix: Narrow wording to G3.5 package boundary and link G8 docs.
Update header if 2026-05-18 evidence is current authority.

Summary: Debug console window kind exists without obvious owned UI surface.
Placeholder surface fallback can hide registry drift.
Impact: Missing mounted components may be found only at runtime.
Recommended Fix: Add config test that every launchable tool is intentionally mounted.
